title: Lemongrass & Ginger Chicken Rice Soup
headnote: External recipe by Isabelle Heikens (At Isabelle's), shared Nov 5, 2026. Earlier claims that the user made and loved this soup were misattributed: that praise described the newsletter author's household. Approximate metric conversions provided for convenience.

ingredientGroups.title: Soup
items: Salt and freshly ground pepper, to taste
½ bunch fresh cilantro, stems finely sliced and leaves reserved
5 scallions, whites and greens sliced, divided
18 g freshly grated ginger (original: 3 tbsp), divided
9 g grated garlic (original: 1 tbsp or 3 large cloves)
1 stalk lemongrass, lower stalk bruised, tough outer leaves removed
140 g jasmine rice (original: ¾ cup; approximate)

steps: Dry the chicken breasts and season with salt and pepper. In a large pot, brown both sides briefly in olive oil, about 2–3 minutes per side; set aside.

Lower the heat and gently soften the coriander, chopped cilantro stems, and about half of the scallions for a few minutes. Add roughly two-thirds of the ginger and the garlic and cook just until aromatic.
Deglaze with a little broth. Add the chicken, remaining broth, bruised lemongrass, and uncooked rice; maintain a gentle simmer.
After approximately 15–20 minutes, check the chicken; remove it when its thickest part reaches 165°F. Let cool slightly and shred.
Continue simmering the rice until very tender and partly broken down, approximately 45–60 minutes total. Remove the lemongrass stalk, return the chicken, and stir in the remaining ginger.
Adjust the seasoning. Finish each serving with cilantro leaves, remaining scallions, fish sauce, and fresh lime juice. Loosen leftovers with broth if needed.
reviewFlags: Third-party newsletter recipe; not established as a user-tested favorite.
Ingredient weights for coriander, ginger, garlic, stock and rice are approximations from the source's volume measures.
